title: #041. Propositional Logic & Access Interlock SAT
subtitle: Model Boolean flags and propositional rules (and, or, not, implies, xor) and check satisfiability with Z3.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { satisfiable, assignment }.
judge.m1: When satisfiable is false, assignment must be null.
judge.m2: Formula is satisfiable, yet output returned satisfiable: false.
judge.m3: Rule {p0} evaluated to false under the returned assignment.
judge.m4: Verified unsatisfiable: no assignment satisfies all propositional rules.
